content:
Die grössten Flughäfen der Vereinigten Staaten nach Passagieraufkommen sind:

1. Hartsfield-Jackson Atlanta International Airport (ATL) in Atlanta, Georgia
2. Los Angeles International Airport (LAX) in Los Angeles, Kalifornien
3. Chicago O'Hare International Airport (ORD) in Chicago, Illinois
4. Dallas/Fort Worth International Airport (DFW) in Dallas/Fort Worth, Texas
5. Denver International Airport (DEN) in Denver, Colorado
6. John F. Kennedy International Airport (JFK) in New York City, New York
7. San Francisco International Airport (SFO) in San Francisco, Kalifornien
8. Seattle-Tacoma International Airport (SEA) in Seattle, Washington
9. McCarran International Airport (LAS) in Las Vegas, Nevada
10. Orlando International Airport (MCO) in Orlando, Florida.
